# 3:17 (Back2SleepNow.com)

> 3:17 is a pre-launch brand making a middle of the night sleep shot for women in menopause who wake in the night. The site has a waitlist for the first batch and a blog of sourced, plain-language articles about night waking in menopause, written by founder Marian Grout. Articles are educational, not medical advice.

## Pages

- [Home and waitlist](https://back2sleepnow.com/): the middle of the night sleep shot, made for women in menopause.
- [Blog](https://back2sleepnow.com/blog): all articles.
- [About Marian Grout](https://back2sleepnow.com/about): founder of 3:17.

## Articles

- [Awake at 3 a.m. and can't get back to sleep? What to do in menopause](https://back2sleepnow.com/blog/cant-get-back-to-sleep-menopause): Woken in the night and can't get back to sleep? Evidence-based steps for menopause night waking, from the 20-minute rule to CBT-I, and when to see a doctor.
- [Why do I wake at 3 a.m. in menopause?](https://back2sleepnow.com/blog/why-wake-3am-menopause): Waking at 3 a.m. in perimenopause or menopause is common. What sleep research says about hot flushes, lighter sleep and other causes, and when to see a doctor.
